title: 最长递增子序列 II
summary: 求最长严格递增子序列，且相邻所选值之差不超过 k。
insight: 处理 value 时，前驱值必须落在 [value-k,value-1]。线段树按数值维护该值结尾的最大长度，区间查询最优前驱后在 value 点更新。
pitfalls: 必须严格递增所以不含 value 本身

solutions.title: 值域线段树 DP
solutions.idea: 区间最大值查询加单点取大更新。

code.java: class Solution { int[] tree;int size;private int query(int node,int left,int right,int ql,int qr){if(ql>right||qr<left)return 0;if(ql<=left&&right<=qr)return tree[node];int middle=(left+right)/2;return Math.max(query(node*2,left,middle,ql,qr),query(node*2+1,middle+1,right,ql,qr));}private void update(int node,int left,int right,int index,int value){if(left==right){tree[node]=Math.max(tree[node],value);return;}int middle=(left+right)/2;if(index<=middle)update(node*2,left,middle,index,value);else update(node*2+1,middle+1,right,index,value);tree[node]=Math.max(tree[node*2],tree[node*2+1]);}public int lengthOfLIS(int[] nums,int k){size=Arrays.stream(nums).max().getAsInt();tree=new int[4*size+4];for(int value:nums){int best=1;if(value>1)best+=query(1,1,size,Math.max(1,value-k),value-1);update(1,1,size,value,best);}return tree[1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun lengthOfLIS(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Int{val size=nums.maxOrNull()!!;val tree=IntArray(4*size+4);fun query(node:Int,left:Int,right:Int,ql:Int,qr:Int):Int{if(ql>right||qr<left)return 0;if(ql<=left&&right<=qr)return tree[node];val middle=(left+right)/2;return maxOf(query(node*2,left,middle,ql,qr),query(node*2+1,middle+1,right,ql,qr))};fun update(node:Int,left:Int,right:Int,index:Int,value:Int){if(left==right){tree[node]=maxOf(tree[node],value);return};val middle=(left+right)/2;if(index<=middle)update(node*2,left,middle,index,value)else update(node*2+1,middle+1,right,index,value);tree[node]=maxOf(tree[node*2],tree[node*2+1])};for(value in nums){var best=1;if(value>1)best+=query(1,1,size,maxOf(1,value-k),value-1);update(1,1,size,value,best)};return tree[1]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> tree;int size;int query(int node,int left,int right,int ql,int qr){if(ql>right||qr<left)return 0;if(ql<=left&&right<=qr)return tree[node];int middle=(left+right)/2;return max(query(node*2,left,middle,ql,qr),query(node*2+1,middle+1,right,ql,qr));}void update(int node,int left,int right,int index,int value){if(left==right){tree[node]=max(tree[node],value);return;}int middle=(left+right)/2;if(index<=middle)update(node*2,left,middle,index,value);else update(node*2+1,middle+1,right,index,value);tree[node]=max(tree[node*2],tree[node*2+1]);}public:int lengthOfLIS(vector<int>& nums,int k){size=*max_element(nums.begin(),nums.end());tree.assign(4*size+4,0);for(int value:nums){int best=1;if(value>1)best+=query(1,1,size,max(1,value-k),value-1);update(1,1,size,value,best);}return tree[1];} };
